description: This Java class provides utility methods for file operations, including reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, and file path normalization, within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FileUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various file operations such as reading, writing, zipping, unzipping, and path normalization, tailored for the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for the given path, resolving component:// URLs to the base location.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file with default or specified encoding; can write to a path and filename.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Searches for files with a specific extension in a directory tree, optionally filtering by partial path and string contents.

methods.name: findXmlFiles
methods.description: Finds XML files in a directory tree that match optional partial path, root element name, or DTD/XSD name.

methods.name: containsString
methods.description: Checks if a given Reader or file contains a specific string.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Returns true if the specified path is an existing file.

methods.name: zipFileStream
methods.description: Creates a zip ByteArrayInputStream from an InputStream and filename, generating a zip with one entry.

methods.name: zipFileStreams
methods.description: Creates a zip ByteArrayInputStream from a map of filenames to input streams, zipping all entries.

methods.name: unzipFileToFolder
methods.description: Extracts a zip file to a specified directory, optionally handling Zip slip security.

methods.name: newFile
methods.description: Returns a secure File object for a zip entry, preventing Zip slip vulnerability.

methods.name: unZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive to a destination folder, supporting optional password for encrypted zip files.

methods.name: createFileWithNormalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a File object with a normalized file path, preventing path traversal issues.

methods.name: normalizeFilePath
methods.description: Returns a string with the normalized file path.
